message.content:
Reorganize the ADMIN sidebar in /opt/nxeon (Next.js 15). The current design collapses to 6 group headers where only the ACTIVE group expands — which leaves a large EMPTY area filling most of the tall sidebar. The owner wants it **organized and filling the vertical space — nothing more, nothing less** (use the space; don't leave a big empty gap; don't overflow awkwardly).

Read: `app/admin/layout.tsx` (has the gates `adminHostBlocked`/`adminIpBlocked`/2FA/impersonation + the badge counts — PRESERVE all of that), `lib/admin-groups.ts` (`ADMIN_GROUPS` = the 6 groups + their items), `components/portal/Shell.tsx` (renders `nav`, supports `children` expandable groups + `badge`). Do NOT touch prisma/schema.prisma, app/dashboard, or app/(marketing). Do NOT run git.

Change the admin sidebar to **grouped sections that are all visible** (the classic, organized "section label + its items listed under it" pattern — like the customer sidebar's Compute/Network/Account sections), so the full nav is on screen and fills the vertical space, instead of collapsing to 6 lone rows. Concretely:
- In `app/admin/layout.tsx`, build the nav as multiple `NavSection`s (one per `ADMIN_GROUPS` entry, using the group label as the section header and the group's items as the section items) — NOT the single-collapsed-group form. Keep role filtering (`canAccessHref`), drop empty sections, and keep the badge counts on the right per-item routes (chat/support/abuse/feedback/improvements).
- `components/portal/Shell.tsx` already renders `NavSection` with a `label` header and flat items — reuse that path (the customer portal uses it). You may remove/bypass the expandable-`children` treatment for admin so items render as visible section lists. Do NOT regress the customer portal (it passes flat sections already).
- Result: the admin sidebar shows all its grouped items (Insights / Customers / Fleet / Revenue / Platform / System with their sub-items visible), organized, filling the height. The nav container already has `overflow-y-auto`, so if the full list is taller than the viewport it scrolls gracefully — that's fine and expected; the goal is no big empty gap and a clear, organized structure.
- If `AdminSubTabs` was removed earlier and pages relied on it, that's fine — navigation now lives fully in the sidebar; leave the SubTabs component unused.

Preserve every gate + the 2FA/impersonation redirects + the badge logic exactly. 

IMPORTANT: Write/Edit may intermittently time out on a hook — fall back to `Bash` heredocs and verify. Do NOT run `npm run build`. Verify ONLY with `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "test/.*test.ts"` (clean for your files) and confirm the CUSTOMER portal Shell usage is unaffected. Report the new sidebar structure.

114	 * Resolve which group a given admin pathname belongs to, by longest matching
115	 * member href. Detail routes (e.g. /admin/users/123) resolve to their group via
116	 * the prefix match. The bare "/admin" only ever matches the Insights overview
117	 * so it never swallows deeper routes.
118	 */
119	export function groupForPath(pathname: string): AdminGroup | null {
120	  let best: { group: AdminGroup; len: number } | null = null;
121	  for (const group of ADMIN_GROUPS) {
122	    for (const item of group.items) {
123	      const matches =
124	        pathname === item.href ||
125	        (item.href !== "/admin" && pathname.startsWith(item.href + "/"));
126	      if (matches && (!best || item.href.length > best.len)) {
127	        best = { group, len: item.href.length };
128	      }
129	    }
130	  }
131	  return best?.group ?? null;
132	}

tsc is clean for the changed files. The customer portal (`app/dashboard/layout.tsx`) passes flat items that always include `icon` and no `children`, so its rendering is byte-for-byte unchanged — the only Shell change on that path is `{item.icon && <Icon .../>}`, which is always truthy for customer items.

## What changed

**`app/admin/layout.tsx`** — Replaced the single collapsed-group nav (one `NavSection` whose items carried `children`) with one visible `NavSection` per group:
```ts
const nav: NavSection[] = visibleGroups.map(({ group, items }) => ({
  label: group.label,
  items: items.map((item) => ({
    label: item.label,
    href: item.href,
    badge: badges[item.href] > 0 ? badges[item.href] : undefined,
  })),
}));
```
Everything else is untouched: `adminHostBlocked` / `adminIpBlocked` gates, 2FA + impersonation redirects, `visibleGroups` role filtering via `canAccessHref` (and the `.filter(items.length > 0)` that drops empty sections), and the per-route badge counts (chat/support/abuse/feedback/improvements).

**`components/portal/Shell.tsx`** — Made `NavItem.icon` optional and guarded both `<Icon name={item.icon} />` render sites with `{item.icon && …}`. The expandable-`children` code path remains but is now dead for admin (admin passes no `children`), so admin items render through the flat-link path as visible section lists.

## New sidebar structure
